title: Add built‑in request body parser middleware
description: Provides first‑class support for parsing JSON and URL‑encoded request bodies without external dependencies. The middleware auto‑detects Content‑Type, populates ctx.body, and integrates with existing routing and error handling, reducing boilerplate for developers.
testCases: Parse a valid JSON payload and verify ctx.body contains the parsed object
Parse a valid application/x-www-form-urlencoded payload and verify ctx.body contains key/value pairs
Reject malformed JSON with a 400 Bad Request error
Ignore bodies for GET/HEAD requests and leave ctx.body undefined
Handle empty body gracefully without throwing
Respect custom limit option (e.g., 1kb) and return 413 Payload Too Large when exceeded
acceptance: When the middleware is registered, POST/PUT/PATCH requests with Content‑Type 'application/json' or 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' are parsed into ctx.body; malformed payloads result in a 400 response; payloads exceeding the configurable size limit result in a 413 response; non‑body methods leave ctx.body untouched; all tests pass and existing routes continue to work unchanged.
reason: Body parsing is a core requirement for any HTTP API. Currently users must pull in third‑party parsers, increasing bundle size and setup complexity. A zero‑dependency, built‑in parser aligns with yantraverse's lightweight philosophy, improves developer experience, and removes a common source of bugs and security issues (e.g., unvalidated payload size).
